module: Flowgraph node "Rally Debug Draw" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Draws debug info for a vehicle every frame: its bounding box (RallyUtil.drawVehBB), a 0.1 m magenta sphere at the front-bottom, a yellow one at the vehicle position and a green one at the received position pos. Inputs: vehId, pos (vec3), rot (quat, unused).
notes: The pos pin must be set when vehId is, otherwise vec3(nil) can fail.

work.desc: Draws via debugDrawer the markers of the vehicle and of the target position.
